name: fetch Response from a local http server
source: import * as http from 'node:http'; async function main(): Promise<void> { const srv = http.createServer((req, res) => { res.statusCode = 201; res.setHeader('x-a', 'b'); res.end('{"k":1}'); }); await new Promise<void>((r) => srv.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => r())); const port = (srv.address() as any).port; const r: Response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:' + port + '/'); console.log(r.status, r.ok, r.headers.get('x-a'), r.statusText); console.log(await r.json()); srv.close(); }
